raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Tuned on one 8x MI300X node with the primus_ci_655d58f_20261026 image. Tokens/s/GPU over 20 iterations, before = the release/v26.9 configs:

  config              before   after
  gpt_oss_20B  BF16    11497   13730
  gpt_oss_20B  FP8     12232   14797
  llama3.1_70B BF16      799     805
  llama3.1_70B FP8       OOM    1184
  llama3.3_70B BF16        -     804
  llama3.3_70B FP8         -    1186

GPT-OSS-20B (BF16 and FP8):
- Run the Turbo grouped GEMM on hipBLASLt; the default Triton backend is slower on MI300X.
- Enable TE fused cross entropy, RoPE fusion, Turbo RMSNorm and gradient accumulation fusion.
- Enable the fused activation-with-probs on sync-free stage 2; stage 3 itself OOMs on 192 GB.
- Raise turbo_deepep_num_cu from 64 to 160.

Llama 3.1 / 3.3 70B (BF16 and FP8):
- Comment out PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True, which cannot run on hosts with older amdgpu drivers.
- Use TE attention instead of Turbo attention.
- FP8: MBS 1, GBS 48, recompute 72 layers. Without expandable segments MBS 3 OOMs and MBS 2 leaves under 1 GB of device memory free.
- Carry over the release/v26.9 settings from #1307 that main lacked: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=4, 20 iterations, BF16 MBS 2 / GBS 16 / recompute 76, and fused cross entropy for llama3.3.

nodes.body:
<!-- pr-pundit-live:primus-1332-1904f010 -->
### PR Pundit review
12 findings, 10 on diff lines below.

**Findings outside the diff lines**

- `examples/megatron/configs/MI300X/llama3.1_70B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:76`: 🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**
    The BF16 llama3.1 and llama3.3 configs keep MBS=2 / recompute_num_layers=76 with the comment '192GB HBM limit: MBS=2 OOMs below 76 layers; MBS=3 OOMs below 80'. The llama3.3 comment adds '(and at 76 without fused CE)'. These values were tuned in #1307 with expandable segments enabled. This PR's own FP8 comments say that without expandable segments MBS=2 no longer fits and leaves under 1 GB free. The BF16 comments are therefore stale, the settings are unverified under the new allocator config, and these configs are likely at or over the OOM edge on MI300X.
    **Evidence:** repo/ and head/ BF16 files have identical comment and values; head FP8 comment says 'Without expandable segments, MBS=3 OOMs and MBS=2 leaves under 1 GB free'
- `tests/trainer/test_megatron_trainer.py:316`: 🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**
    No test properly validates the tuned values. On gfx942, test_gpt_oss_20B_sink_attention loads the MI300X gpt_oss_20B-BF16 config, so per-PR CI silently inherits every new knob: hipblaslt grouped GEMM, turbo rms norm / norm_te_linear, fused act with probs at sync-free stage 2, rope fusion, grad-accum fusion, deepep_num_cu=160 and TE fused CE. These now combine with sink attention at MBS=2 and 4 layers, so they are exercised only indirectly with a 4-layer override. The tests force --use_turbo_attention 1 and small MBS. No test loads the llama3.1/3.3 configs with use_turbo_attention false. The PR does not show this E2E test was run on MI300X with the new config, and the test name no longer describes everything it covers.
    **Evidence:** Read test_megatron_trainer.py:316-341 and its GPU_PLATFORM mapping (gfx942 -> MI300X).

🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True is commented out in all four MI300X llama 70B configs, and no reason is given in the YAML (perf regression? driver hang? probe failure?). The new MBS comments depend on this change. It forces the FP8 configs from MBS=3 down to MBS=1, a large per-step efficiency loss. It also leaves dead config, so a future maintainer cannot tell whether to re-enable it or what the trade-off is. The project's own runner hook (runner/helpers/hooks/05_check_expandable_segments.py) and rocm_arg_validation both treat expandable segments as the recommended setting. The reason should be documented in a comment, or the line deleted; otherwise this is a regression dressed as tuning.

**Evidence:** diff of the 4 llama files; read 05_check_expandable_segments.py and warn_turbo_grouped_gemm_without_expandable_segments in rocm_arg_validation.py

**Related past reviews:** [#824](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/824) on `production_docs/02-user-guide/training-recipes.md`

🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

In both FP8 llama configs (llama3.1 and llama3.3, lines 24-25), micro_batch_size drops from 3 to 1 and recompute_num_layers from 80 to 72 at GBS=48. This triples the number of gradient-accumulation micro-steps, a likely throughput regression in a 'perf: tune' PR. The only stated reason is to fit without expandable segments, which the PR disables without explanation. No numbers show that this beats MBS=3 with expandable segments. Recomputing 72 of 80 layers at MBS=1 is a different trade-off that is not explained. The change alters the benchmark's shape, so results are not comparable with earlier MI300X numbers or with the MI300X sibling (MBS=3), and benchmark workflow baselines will shift. It also invalidates the documented 8-node commands in docs/02-user-guide/megatron-lm-training.md:652,676 (--micro_batch_size 4 ... --recompute_num_layers 80), which were not updated.

**Evidence:** grep of docs/02-user-guide/megatron-lm-training.md and .github/workflows/benchmark.yaml:88-179

**Related past reviews:** [#824](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/824) on `production_docs/02-user-guide/pretraining.md`

nodes.body:
🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

gradient_accumulation_fusion is flipped to true with overlap_grad_reduce and overlap_param_gather on, and with Turbo grouped GEMM and DeepEP in use. Maintainers previously had to turn it off on MoE configs because of compatibility and perf problems with the overlap flags. Every other MI300X MoE recipe (deepseek, mixtral) and the MI355X gpt_oss_20B sibling keep it false. Several Primus-Turbo local linear paths (FP8/MXFP4 local linears) reject this flag with a ValueError. The Turbo grouped-linear main_grad path asserts that main_grad attributes exist when fusion is on. There is no note or test confirming the hybrid-FP8 path is compatible. The PR gives no rationale and no perf or convergence evidence; loss parity is needed, not only throughput. The same applies to the FP8 config, which also turns on apply_rope_fusion.

**Evidence:** grep of gradient_accumulation_fusion across head/examples/megatron/configs/MI300X and MI355X; primus_turbo.py:371-406 main_grad handling

**Related past reviews:** [#145](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/145) on `examples/megatron/configs/deepseek_v2-pretrain.yaml`

🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**

apply_rope_fusion: true overrides primus/configs/models/megatron/gpt_oss_20B.yaml:16, which deliberately sets it to false (gpt_oss_120B.yaml does the same). The preset is left unchanged and no reason is given, so the example and the model preset now disagree. The model inherits deepseek_v2_base rotary settings (rotary_scaling_factor 40, mscale 0.707). If the effective mscale != 1.0, Megatron's apply_rotary_pos_emb silently warns and falls back to the unfused path, so the flag may give no speedup. Confirm loss parity and that the fused kernel is actually taken, and either change the preset or document why the MI300X example differs. The same applies to the FP8 config.

**Evidence:** Read gpt_oss_20B.yaml:16, gpt_oss_120B.yaml:16 and deepseek_v2_base.yaml:9-10. The MI355X sibling does set apply_rope_fusion: true, so this is plausible but undocumented.

🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**

The llama3.3 configs (BF16 and FP8) keep use_turbo_grouped_gemm: true while expandable segments are removed. gpt_oss also enables grouped GEMM, including via sync-free stage 2, without expandable segments. As a result, warn_turbo_grouped_gemm_without_expandable_segments() emits a fragmentation and peak-memory warning on every run, telling users to set PYTORCH_HIP_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True. That contradicts the config. On a dense Llama model with no experts, the flag has no effect, so the warning is pure noise. Either drop use_turbo_grouped_gemm or keep expandable segments, or explain why they must stay off.

**Evidence:** rocm_arg_validation.py:138-153 warns whenever use_turbo_grouped_gemm is set and expandable_segments_requested() is False

nodes.body:
🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**

The comment 'the default Triton grouped GEMM is slower on MI300X' is misleading. Primus-Turbo's default grouped GEMM backend is CK: grouped_gemm.py and grouped_gemm_fp8.py pass default_backend=BackendType.CK. Primus only forwards the backend string when it is not 'default' (_apply_turbo_grouped_gemm_backend_env), so what 'default' resolves to depends on the installed Turbo build and may change. The justification for the override is therefore wrong or fragile. The same comment appears in the FP8 config at line 84.

**Evidence:** primus_turbo.py:233-239; rocm_arg_validation sync_free_moe stage map

**Related past reviews:** [#220](https://github.com/AMD-AGI/Primus/pull/220) on `tests/trainer/test_megatron_trainer.py`

nodes.body:
🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**

The comment "stage 3's fused activation; stage 3 itself OOMs on MI300X" is misleading. It explains where the flag comes from, not why it is safe or faster here. use_turbo_fused_act_with_probs is an independent flag, used here with stage 2, that stage 3 merely auto-enables. It requires glu_linear_offset == 0, no activation_func_fp8_input_store, and a gated silu/gelu activation; otherwise PrimusGroupedMLP raises at runtime. Real GPT-OSS uses a clamped swiglu with an offset, so a more faithful preset would break it. Under fp8: hybrid with sync-free stage 2, moe_router_padding_for_quantization is auto-set True, so the fused kernel receives padded tokens_per_expert and probs. This combination is untested, and the MI355X sibling does not enable it. Both BF16 and FP8 configs are affected.

**Evidence:** Read primus/backends/megatron/core/transformer/experts.py:179-203.

🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**

The comment "stage 3's fused activation; stage 3 itself OOMs on MI300X" is misleading. It explains where the flag comes from, not why it is safe or faster here. use_turbo_fused_act_with_probs is an independent flag, used here with stage 2, that stage 3 merely auto-enables. It requires glu_linear_offset == 0, no activation_func_fp8_input_store, and a gated silu/gelu activation; otherwise PrimusGroupedMLP raises at runtime. Real GPT-OSS uses a clamped swiglu with an offset, so a more faithful preset would break it. Under fp8: hybrid with sync-free stage 2, moe_router_padding_for_quantization is auto-set True, so the fused kernel receives padded tokens_per_expert and probs. This combination is untested, and the MI355X sibling does not enable it. Both BF16 and FP8 configs are affected.

### PR Pundit review
12 findings, 10 on diff lines below.

**Findings outside the diff lines**

- `examples/megatron/configs/MI300X/llama3.1_70B-BF16-pretrain.yaml:76`: 🟠 Should fix **[PR Pundit]**
    The BF16 llama3.1 and llama3.3 configs keep MBS=2 / recompute_num_layers=76 with the comment '192GB HBM limit: MBS=2 OOMs below 76 layers; MBS=3 OOMs below 80'. The llama3.3 comment adds '(and at 76 without fused CE)'. These values were tuned in #1307 with expandable segments enabled. This PR's own FP8 comments say that without expandable segments MBS=2 no longer fits and leaves under 1 GB free. The BF16 comments are therefore stale, the settings are unverified under the new allocator config, and these configs are likely at or over the OOM edge on MI300X.
    **Evidence:** repo/ and head/ BF16 files have identical comment and values; head FP8 comment says 'Without expandable segments, MBS=3 OOMs and MBS=2 leaves under 1 GB free'
- `tests/trainer/test_megatron_trainer.py:316`: 🔵 Minor **[PR Pundit]**
    No test properly validates the tuned values. On gfx942, test_gpt_oss_20B_sink_attention loads the MI300X gpt_oss_20B-BF16 config, so per-PR CI silently inherits every new knob: hipblaslt grouped GEMM, turbo rms norm / norm_te_linear, fused act with probs at sync-free stage 2, rope fusion, grad-accum fusion, deepep_num_cu=160 and TE fused CE. These now combine with sink attention at MBS=2 and 4 layers, so they are exercised only indirectly with a 4-layer override. The tests force --use_turbo_attention 1 and small MBS. No test loads the llama3.1/3.3 configs with use_turbo_attention false. The PR does not show this E2E test was run on MI300X with the new config, and the test name no longer describes everything it covers.
    **Evidence:** Read test_megatron_trainer.py:316-341 and its GPU_PLATFORM mapping (gfx942 -> MI300X).
